// The alert link's own code, run in one process for alarmd's end-to-end
// test of the filter close (filterclose/linkd_e2e_test.go). It is not built
// with alarmd: the test builds it inside the link's module (pkg/linkd at
// Linkd b7e5beddf) as cmd/alarmd-filter-harness/main.go through
// go build -overlay, which leaves the module's tree as it is, because only
// that module can import the link's internal packages.
//
// What runs is the link's: the source service and its published release
// (eventsource), the standard cleaner and the event factory (cleaner), the
// lifecycle processor over the in-memory repository (lifecycle,
// store/memory), and the management API with its Internal-Token check and
// its alert search, filtered close and single close handlers
// (controlplane/api). Two pieces are the harness's own, because the link
// serves them only over Elasticsearch storage: the search reader evaluates
// the query clauses alarmd sends (bool, term, terms, exists, range on
// create_at) over the
// repository's alerts, and the closer runs the processor's CloseAlert and
// classifies its errors as the link's AlertCloser does
// (internal/lifecycle/process/close.go:251-273), with no lease or KAC
// projection. Faults can be injected into the closer: -busy-every answers
// every nth close 429 busy before trying, -uncertain-every saves every nth
// close and then answers 502 result_uncertain.
//
// Two routes are the harness's own: POST /harness/events takes one raw
// event as the link's Kafka consumer would and processes it, and GET
// /harness/alert?tenant=&id= answers an alert's status and close count.
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"log/slog"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	"linkd/internal/cleaner"
	"linkd/internal/config"
	"linkd/internal/controlplane/api"
	"linkd/internal/domain"
	"linkd/internal/enrich"
	"linkd/internal/eventsource"
	"linkd/internal/lifecycle"
	lifecycleprocess "linkd/internal/lifecycle/process"
	"linkd/internal/store"
	"linkd/internal/store/memory"
)

// documents is the source service's store, in memory.
type documents struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	docs map[string]json.RawMessage
	revs map[string]string
}

func (d *documents) Get(_ context.Context, collection, key string) (json.RawMessage, string, error) {
	d.mu.Lock()
	defer d.mu.Unlock()
	value, ok := d.docs[collection+"/"+key]
	if !ok {
		return nil, "", eventsource.ErrNotFound
	}
	return value, d.revs[collection+"/"+key], nil
}

func (d *documents) Put(_ context.Context, collection, key, expected string, value json.RawMessage) error {
	d.mu.Lock()
	defer d.mu.Unlock()
	if d.revs[collection+"/"+key] != expected {
		return eventsource.ErrConflict
	}
	d.docs[collection+"/"+key] = append(json.RawMessage(nil), value...)
	next, _ := strconv.Atoi(expected)
	d.revs[collection+"/"+key] = strconv.Itoa(next + 1)
	return nil
}

func (d *documents) List(_ context.Context, collection, after string, limit int) ([]json.RawMessage, error) {
	d.mu.Lock()
	defer d.mu.Unlock()
	var keys []string
	for key := range d.docs {
		if strings.HasPrefix(key, collection+"/") && strings.TrimPrefix(key, collection+"/") > after {
			keys = append(keys, key)
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	var out []json.RawMessage
	for _, key := range keys {
		if len(out) == limit {
			break
		}
		out = append(out, d.docs[key])
	}
	return out, nil
}

type clock struct{}

func (clock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC() }

type logger struct{}

func (logger) WarnContext(_ context.Context, message string, args ...any) {
	log.Println(append([]any{message}, args...)...)
}

// tracked is the memory repository with the ids of the alerts it created,
// which the search reads (the memory store lists no alerts).
type tracked struct {
	*memory.Repository
	mu  sync.Mutex
	ids map[string][]string
}

func (r *tracked) CreateAlert(ctx context.Context, alert domain.Alert) (store.CreateAlertResult, error) {
	result, err := r.Repository.CreateAlert(ctx, alert)
	if err == nil {
		r.mu.Lock()
		r.ids[alert.BKTenantID] = append(r.ids[alert.BKTenantID], alert.AlertID)
		r.mu.Unlock()
	}
	return result, err
}

// reader is the search over the repository: the query evaluated on each
// alert's JSON as the link's mapping indexes it - labels.* and
// dimensions.* flattened, every value a keyword.
type reader struct{ repository *tracked }

func keyword(value any) (string, bool) {
	switch v := value.(type) {
	case string:
		return v, true
	case json.Number:
		return v.String(), true
	case bool:
		return strconv.FormatBool(v), true
	}
	return "", false
}

func fieldOf(alert map[string]any, name string) (string, bool) {
	for _, prefix := range []string{"labels.", "dimensions."} {
		if strings.HasPrefix(name, prefix) {
			inner, _ := alert[strings.TrimSuffix(prefix, ".")].(map[string]any)
			value, ok := inner[strings.TrimPrefix(name, prefix)]
			if !ok {
				return "", false
			}
			return keyword(value)
		}
	}
	value, ok := alert[name]
	if !ok {
		return "", false
	}
	return keyword(value)
}

var errClause = errors.New("unsupported query clause")

func matches(query json.RawMessage, alert map[string]any) (bool, error) {
	var clause map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(query, &clause); err != nil || len(clause) != 1 {
		return false, errClause
	}
	for kind, body := range clause {
		switch kind {
		case "match_all":
			return true, nil
		case "term":
			var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
			if json.Unmarshal(body, &fields) != nil || len(fields) != 1 {
				return false, errClause
			}
			for name, raw := range fields {
				var value any
				decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
				decoder.UseNumber()
				_ = decoder.Decode(&value)
				want, _ := keyword(value)
				got, ok := fieldOf(alert, name)
				return ok && got == want, nil
			}
		case "terms":
			var fields map[string][]json.RawMessage
			if json.Unmarshal(body, &fields) != nil || len(fields) != 1 {
				return false, errClause
			}
			for name, values := range fields {
				got, ok := fieldOf(alert, name)
				for _, raw := range values {
					var value any
					decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
					decoder.UseNumber()
					_ = decoder.Decode(&value)
					if want, _ := keyword(value); ok && got == want {
						return true, nil
					}
				}
				return false, nil
			}
		case "range":
			// Elasticsearch's range on a date_nanos field (alert-search.md
			// "可查询字段"); the harness ranges create_at only, the field
			// alarmd bounds.
			var fields map[string]map[string]string
			if json.Unmarshal(body, &fields) != nil || len(fields) != 1 || fields["create_at"] == nil {
				return false, errClause
			}
			text, _ := alert["create_at"].(string)
			created, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, text)
			if err != nil {
				return false, nil
			}
			for op, bound := range fields["create_at"] {
				at, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, bound)
				if err != nil {
					return false, errClause
				}
				switch op {
				case "gte":
					if created.Before(at) {
						return false, nil
					}
				case "gt":
					if !created.After(at) {
						return false, nil
					}
				case "lte":
					if created.After(at) {
						return false, nil
					}
				case "lt":
					if !created.Before(at) {
						return false, nil
					}
				default:
					return false, errClause
				}
			}
			return true, nil
		case "exists":
			var field struct {
				Field string `json:"field"`
			}
			if json.Unmarshal(body, &field) != nil {
				return false, errClause
			}
			_, ok := fieldOf(alert, field.Field)
			return ok, nil
		case "bool":
			var b struct {
				Filter  []json.RawMessage `json:"filter"`
				MustNot []json.RawMessage `json:"must_not"`
				Should  []json.RawMessage `json:"should"`
				Minimum *int              `json:"minimum_should_match"`
			}
			if json.Unmarshal(body, &b) != nil {
				return false, errClause
			}
			for _, sub := range b.Filter {
				if ok, err := matches(sub, alert); err != nil || !ok {
					return false, err
				}
			}
			for _, sub := range b.MustNot {
				if ok, err := matches(sub, alert); err != nil || ok {
					return false, err
				}
			}
			if len(b.Should) == 0 {
				return true, nil
			}
			minimum := 0
			if b.Minimum != nil {
				minimum = *b.Minimum
			} else if len(b.Filter) == 0 {
				minimum = 1
			}
			hit := 0
			for _, sub := range b.Should {
				ok, err := matches(sub, alert)
				if err != nil {
					return false, err
				}
				if ok {
					hit++
				}
			}
			return hit >= minimum, nil
		}
	}
	return false, errClause
}

func (r reader) SearchAlerts(ctx context.Context, request store.AlertSearchRequest) (store.AlertSearchPage, error) {
	r.repository.mu.Lock()
	ids := append([]string(nil), r.repository.ids[request.TenantID]...)
	r.repository.mu.Unlock()
	sort.Strings(ids)
	page := store.AlertSearchPage{Items: []domain.Alert{}}
	for _, id := range ids {
		if id <= request.After {
			continue
		}
		stored, err := r.repository.GetAlert(ctx, request.TenantID, id)
		if err != nil {
			return store.AlertSearchPage{}, err
		}
		encoded, _ := json.Marshal(stored.Alert)
		var alert map[string]any
		decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(encoded))
		decoder.UseNumber()
		_ = decoder.Decode(&alert)
		ok := true
		if len(request.Query) > 0 {
			ok, err = matches(request.Query, alert)
			if err != nil {
				return store.AlertSearchPage{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %v", store.ErrInvalidArgument, err)
			}
		}
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		if len(page.Items) == request.Limit {
			page.Next = page.Items[len(page.Items)-1].AlertID
			return page, nil
		}
		page.Items = append(page.Items, stored.Alert)
	}
	return page, nil
}

// closer is the processor's CloseAlert, classified as the link's
// AlertCloser classifies it, with the faults asked for.
type closer struct {
	processor      *lifecycle.Processor
	mu             sync.Mutex
	calls          int
	busyEvery      int
	uncertainEvery int
	closes         map[string]int
}

func (c *closer) CloseAlert(ctx context.Context, command lifecycle.CloseAlertCommand) (lifecycle.CloseAlertResult, error) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	c.calls++
	n := c.calls
	c.mu.Unlock()
	if c.busyEvery > 0 && n%c.busyEvery == 0 {
		return lifecycle.CloseAlertResult{}, &lifecycleprocess.CloseError{Status: 429, Code: "busy", Message: "alert is being processed; retry the same operation"}
	}
	result, err := c.processor.CloseAlert(ctx, command)
	if err == nil && !result.AlreadyClosed {
		c.mu.Lock()
		c.closes[command.AlertID]++
		c.mu.Unlock()
	}
	switch {
	case err == nil && c.uncertainEvery > 0 && n%c.uncertainEvery == 0:
		return result, &lifecycleprocess.CloseError{Status: 502, Code: "result_uncertain", Message: "alert closed but KAC write failed; retry the same operation"}
	case err == nil:
		return result, nil
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrNotFound):
		return result, &lifecycleprocess.CloseError{Status: 404, Code: "not_found", Message: "alert or source not found"}
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrInvalidTransition):
		return result, &lifecycleprocess.CloseError{Status: 409, Code: "invalid_transition", Message: "alert state changed; refresh before another operation"}
	case errors.Is(err, store.ErrVersionConflict):
		return result, &lifecycleprocess.CloseError{Status: 409, Code: "version_conflict", Message: "alert version changed; retry the same operation"}
	}
	return result, &lifecycleprocess.CloseError{Status: 502, Code: "result_uncertain", Message: "close result uncertain; retry the same operation"}
}

func main() {
	secret := flag.String("secret", "", "the dispatch JWT secret")
	busyEvery := flag.Int("busy-every", 0, "answer every nth close 429 busy")
	uncertainEvery := flag.Int("uncertain-every", 0, "save every nth close and answer 502")
	flag.Parse()

	source := config.EventSource{EventSourceID: "built_in_bk", Enabled: true, Cleaner: config.CleanerConfig{Type: config.CleanerTypeStandard},
		Storage: config.EventSourceStorageConfig{Type: config.StorageTypeKafka, Kafka: config.KafkaStorageConfig{
			Brokers: []string{"192.0.2.1:9092"}, Topic: "alarmd-trigger-event", ConsumerGroup: "linkd"}}}
	severity := config.SeverityConfig{}.WithDefaults()
	sources := eventsource.New(&documents{docs: map[string]json.RawMessage{}, revs: map[string]string{}}, severity)
	ctx := context.Background()
	if _, err := sources.Apply(ctx, source, 0, false, "harness"); err != nil {
		log.Fatal("publish source: ", err)
	}
	record, err := sources.Get(ctx, "built_in_bk")
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	release, err := sources.GetRelease(ctx, record.ID, record.Published)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	published := release.Spec

	repository := &tracked{Repository: memory.New(), ids: map[string][]string{}}
	processor, err := lifecycle.NewProcessor(repository, lifecycle.NoopRecentAlertCache{}, lifecycle.DeterministicAlertIDGenerator{},
		enrich.NoopEnricher{}, nil, severity, clock{}, logger{})
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal("processor: ", err)
	}
	factory, err := cleaner.NewEventFactory(published, severity)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal("factory: ", err)
	}
	standard := cleaner.StandardCleaner{Rules: published.Cleaner.Rules}
	closes := &closer{processor: processor, busyEvery: *busyEvery, uncertainEvery: *uncertainEvery, closes: map[string]int{}}
	search := api.NewAlertSearch(reader{repository: repository}, config.AlertSearchConfig{}, slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(os.Stderr, nil)))

	var records int
	var mu sync.Mutex
	mux := http.NewServeMux()
	mux.Handle("/api/", (&api.API{Sources: sources, AlertSearch: search, AlertCloser: closes,
		Config: config.DispatchConfig{JWT: config.JWTConfig{SecretKey: *secret}}}).Handler())
	mux.HandleFunc("POST /harness/events", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		payload, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		records++
		message := cleaner.RawEventMessage{RecordID: "record-" + strconv.Itoa(records), EventSourceID: "built_in_bk", ReceivedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Payload: payload}
		draft, err := standard.Clean(r.Context(), message)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "clean: "+err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		event, err := factory.Build(message, draft)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "build: "+err.Error(), http.StatusBadRequest)
			return
		}
		created, err := repository.CreateEvent(r.Context(), event)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "store: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		if _, err := processor.ProcessEvent(r.Context(), created.StoredEvent); err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "lifecycle: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		active, err := repository.FindActiveAlert(r.Context(), store.ActiveAlertKey{BKTenantID: event.BKTenantID, EventSourceID: "built_in_bk",
			Fingerprint: event.Fingerprint})
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "no active alert: "+err.Error(), http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{"alert_id": active.Alert.AlertID, "fingerprint": event.Fingerprint})
	})
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /harness/alert", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		stored, err := repository.GetAlert(r.Context(), r.URL.Query().Get("tenant"), r.URL.Query().Get("id"))
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, err.Error(), http.StatusNotFound)
			return
		}
		closes.mu.Lock()
		n := closes.closes[stored.Alert.AlertID]
		closes.mu.Unlock()
		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{"status": stored.Alert.Status, "closes": n})
	})
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(listener.Addr().String())
	log.Fatal(http.Serve(listener, mux))
}
